hook: 삼성 낸드의 약 40%가 중국 시안에서 나옵니다.
titles: VEU 철회 뒤 중국 투자 68% 늘린 이유
description:
미국이 2025년 8월 삼성·SK하이닉스 중국 공장의 VEU 지위를 철회하고 연간 허가 체계로 바꾼 뒤, 두 회사는 오히려 중국 투자를 늘렸습니다. 그런데 2026년 10월 15일 기준 SK하이닉스 다롄 공장의 2027년분 허가는 아직 나오지 않았습니다. 시안·우시·다롄 공장이 매년 미국의 승인에 달린 구조를 정리했습니다.

sentences.text: 삼성 낸드의 약 40%가 중국 시안에서 나옵니다.

asset_pick.reason: Centered worker between symmetric rows of fab equipment reads instantly as a NAND fab; subject mid-frame, lower third is calm reflective floor. Candidate 1 is similar but busier and less tight.

sentences.text: 그런데 그 공장 장비 반입 허가가 1년짜리거든요.
sentences.speaker: main
sentences.visual: Official export license document on a desk beside a calendar showing a single year, stamp and pen nearby, dim office lighting, tense mood, editorial illustration, no readable text
sentences.visual_final: Close-up of a single stamped permit sheet lying on a dark wooden desk, a brass rubber stamp and fountain pen beside it, a wall calendar out of focus behind with one month torn away, dim amber desk lamp, blank desk surface in the lower third.

asset_pick.reason: Both permit papers have AI-garbled text, but candidate 0's large headline 'AUTICE PERPIOT YERBOIT' is blatantly fake across the middle. Candidate 1 at least reads 'PERMIT', the garble is small, and the paper sits where the caption will partly cover it.

sentences.text: 미국은 왜 매년 다시 심사하는 걸까요?

sentences.visual_final: Night harbor, a huge crane hook lowering a wooden crate of chipmaking equipment under a single harsh spotlight, customs inspector silhouette on the quay with a flashlight beam cutting the fog, calm dark water across the lower third.

asset_pick.reason: Container hanging over a ship under a spotlight with an inspector — centered mid-frame, suggests scrutiny/approval of a shipment; lower third is calm dark water. Candidate 1 pushes the subject to the left edge.

sentences.text: 시작은 2022년 10월이었습니다.

sentences.visual_final: Neoclassical government building with white columns at dusk, autumn leaves drifting across an empty stone plaza, long shadows, low eye-level shot from the plaza edge, muted blue sky with a thin amber horizon, smooth paving stones occupying the lower third.

asset_pick.reason: Government-style building with lit windows and fallen autumn leaves (October mood) fills the upper/middle; lower third is empty wet pavement for the caption. Candidate 0 wastes the upper third on blank sky.

sentences.text: 첨단 장비의 대중 수출을 허가제로 묶었거든요.
sentences.speaker: main

sentences.visual_final: Stacked steel shipping containers on a dock wrapped in thick red customs straps and heavy padlocks, overcast grey sky, low angle looking up at the stack, a single gull flying overhead, wet empty concrete pier in the lower third.

asset_pick.reason: Candidate 0 has obvious fake lettering on the container doors ('TO 6', 'LUSTIN ENCUL'). Candidate 1's red lockdown straps and padlocks convey 'export restricted' with only tiny indistinct markings; no readable garble.

sentences.text: 삼성·SK는 2023년 10월 VEU 지위를 받았죠.

asset_pick.reason: Symmetrical factory gate opened onto a sunrise says 'permission granted' at a glance; gate centered in upper/middle, lower third is calm wet asphalt. Candidate 1 is off-center with a distracting guard booth and chimney.

sentences.text: 미국산 장비를 개별 허가 없이 들일 수 있던 제도죠.

asset_pick.reason: Clean convoy of wrapped equipment centered mid-frame, no artifacts; cand1 has a detached-looking shadow and an orange lens-flare blob in the lower third.

sentences.text: 그런데 2025년 8월 29일, 상무부가 움직였습니다.

sentences.visual_final: Empty government press room, a wooden podium with a cluster of microphones under harsh fluorescent light, rows of vacant chairs facing it, heavy curtains behind, shot from the back aisle, dark carpet floor across the lower third.

asset_pick.reason: Podium with microphones sits mid-frame and the lower third is plain carpet, leaving room for the caption; cand1's lower third is cluttered with chairs.

sentences.text: "바이든 시대 허점"

asset_pick.reason: Glowing crack and the hand covering it are centered with a calm wall below; glove and fingers look natural. cand1 pushes the glow to the top and the arm into the lower third.

sentences.text: 상무부는 VEU를 이렇게 부르며 철회했습니다.

sentences.visual_final: Overhead view of a factory blueprint on a steel drafting table, a green wax seal being peeled away leaving a ragged torn circle, a chrome letter opener resting nearby, cold grey office window light, empty table edge in the lower third.

asset_pick.reason: Broken wax seal on the document reads as 'revoked' at a glance, less garbled fine print, and the lower third is quiet; cand1 has more visible fake lettering and odd tools.

sentences.text: 확장·고도화용 장비는 허가 안 준다는 방침이었죠.

sentences.visual_final: Split industrial hall interior, left side a working production line glowing blue with moving robotic arms, right side a sealed red steel shutter with new crates stacked outside it, overhead spotlights, polished dark floor across the lower third.

asset_pick.reason: Coherent single scene: robot line on one side, closed red shutter blocking the equipment crates on the other, with an empty floor for the caption. cand1's hard split-screen seam looks artificial.

sentences.text: 대상은 삼성 시안과 SK 우시·다롄 공장입니다.

asset_pick.reason: No garbled text; aerial fab-site shot with calm lower-third terrain. cand1 has fake watermark lettering in the bottom-left corner, which fails the artifact check.

sentences.text: 그런데 발효 직전, 2026년분 연간 허가가 나왔죠.

asset_pick.reason: Silhouetted executive at window over hazy industrial skyline conveys relief; subject sits higher in frame and the lower third is darker floor, leaving room for the quote.

sentences.text: 그런데 규제 속에서도 2025년 중국 투자는 늘었습니다.

asset_pick.reason: Candidate 0 has fake lettering on the boxes (RUMALL etc.); candidate 1's tall stack and forklift show growing volume with no readable text and an empty concrete lower third.

sentences.text: 시안 투자가 4654억 원, 약 68% 늘었거든요.

asset_pick.reason: Candidate 0's crane load carries garbled text; candidate 1 has clean cranes and a rising structure at sunrise, matching the big investment increase with a calm lower third.

sentences.text: SK하이닉스 다롄도 4406억 원, 52% 증가였죠.

asset_pick.reason: Foggy industrial plant matches a fab investment better than a cargo ship; cool haze matches s15/s17 palette and the water below is calm for caption.

sentences.text: 그런데 10월 15일, 로이터 보도가 나왔습니다.

sentences.visual_final: Row of wooden equipment crates waiting on pallets outside a sealed grey steel fab module door, an idle yellow forklift parked beside them, overcast flat light, puddles on the loading dock, wet empty concrete across the lower third.

sentences.text: 그런데 2027년분 다롄 허가는 15일 기준 아직입니다.
